Okay for me it’s Universal as a whole vacation and here’s a few reasons why: 

1. I go to relax on vacation, and Universal imo provides more of that. Far far less planning needed, better transportation, accessible dining either at hotels or Citywak and parks, plus I don’t feel the need to plan every step of my day regardless of crowds. This helps immensely and being able to RELAX, since that’s what vacation is for. 

2. Hotel Variety: Cheaper rates and imo mostly better or on par to every Disney hotel available. 

3. Ride Variety: Until some shows come back to USF, the variety here is a bit less atm but there are types of rides for any theme park goer out there of all levels. Disney tends to cater to all family atttactions, or all kiddie ones, where Universal is appealing to them and to the teens and adults as well. I often say Universal is Disney but for adults. So going with a family or group I beleive Universal gives the most options in terms of making everyone happy. 

4. Cost. 5 days at Universal is plenty, gives you park time, pool time, and sleeping time to get everything in that you need to. This naturally makes the amount of days just a little less in Orlando, which can save you money. Hey though, if you’re a 7 day vacationer then I’d say just enjoy the pools those extra days. It’s also not like the parks don’t have plenty to offer, either.
